subject: TURN directive
notes: cite.py --check 7.3.25.4 "if exception-name-1 EC-ALL is specified" OK. DirectiveCovers: exact name match first, then level3==EC-I-O-WARNING -> false, then EC-ALL -> true; used for ON and OFF alike. Probes: TRNF7 '>>TURN EC-ALL CHECKING ON' -> READ AT END on F1 sets EC-I-O-AT-END; TRNO1 '>>TURN EC-ALL CHECKING ON' + OPEN INPUT OPTIONAL missing file (status 05) -> EXCEPTION-STATUS spaces (WARNING not enabled by EC-ALL, as GR2 requires); TRNO4 WARNING explicit ON then EC-ALL OFF -> WARNING still raised (EC-ALL OFF does not cover it). Both halves verified. || editions (adjudicator): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the TURN directive is a COBOL-2002 introduction; §7.3 compiler directives); the EC-I-O-WARNING carve-out is observable only at 2023 (EC-I-O-WARNING is a 2023 addition, Annex E)
